facts_line: 5 bedrooms · 2.75 baths · 2,772 sq ft · backs to the greenbelt
pitch: Over $100K in upgrades, a soaring great room, Mount Rainier from the upstairs windows and a new 24×22 covered deck over the greenbelt.
reasons: from the primary suite and two more bedrooms.

rooms.title: The kitchen
rooms.story: A soaring two-story great room with fireplace opens to the kitchen: an oversized island, white shaker cabinetry, brass hardware, a gas range and a walk-in pantry.

rooms.title: The great room
rooms.story: A two-story room with a fireplace, open to the kitchen. Custom millwork, designer accents and updated lighting run through the main floor.
rooms.note: Look up: two full stories of light.

rooms.title: The primary suite
rooms.story: Mount Rainier views, a soaking tub, a frameless glass shower and a custom closet system.
rooms.note: Look out the window on a clear morning.

rooms.title: The covered deck
rooms.story: New 24×22 covered outdoor living with composite decking and a plumbed fire pit, beside a large covered storage closet.
rooms.note: Picture a fall evening out here.

rooms.title: The greenbelt
rooms.story: A generous fenced lot backing to recorded open-space greenbelt and towering evergreens.
rooms.note: Step out to the edge of the greenbelt.

rooms.title: The mudroom
rooms.story: A beautifully appointed mudroom, plus an extra-long garage with kick-out storage.
rooms.note: The drop zone every family wants.

talkers.title: Mount Rainier lives right here.
talkers.line: On a clear day, the mountain fills the upstairs windows.

talkers.title: Wired with Cat-6.
talkers.line: Fast, reliable wired internet for working from home, streaming and gaming.

talkers.title: Central air conditioning.
talkers.line: The unit sits outside, so it’s easy to miss. Summers stay comfortable.

talkers.title: The fire pit is plumbed in.
talkers.line: No propane tanks to haul. It’s part of the new 24×22 covered deck.

talkers.title: An EV charger is already here.
talkers.line: Ready for an electric car on day one, with an extra-long garage.
